dog.description_text:
I'm available for adoption at ACC's Mobile Adoption Event on Saturday, October 10 from 12pm - 4pm with Koeppel Subaru at 42-01 Northern Blvd, Long Island City, NY 11101Adoptions are in-person and first come, first served, so make sure to get there early. You can apply for me now, but it will not put me on hold for you. I can't wait to meet you!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I have medical needs that staff will address with you when you meet me.

I love getting pets and - you guessed it - snuggles!

Where can you find me?

I am at the location.

We unfortunately can not put animals on HOLD over the phone

Dear Customer, please understand to prevent disappointment, this website is live and updates frequently, there is chance that when you would arrive at our location the animal you have an interest in might have been adopted or another party might be going through the adoption process at that present time
dog.name: Banana Pudding
